description: Hottel-Whillier-Bliss steady-state model for evacuated tube collector (very low U_L due to vacuum insulation)

unit.name: Generic 30-tube Evacuated Tube Collector (Apricus AP-30 style)
unit.source: Duffie & Beckman (2013), 'Solar Engineering of Thermal Processes', 4th ed., Wiley, Ch.6; SRCC OG-100 certified ETC ratings

F_R_tau_alpha.note: Heat removal factor * optical efficiency F_R*(tau*alpha) — slightly lower than flat-plate due to glass tube geometry but compensated by IAM

F_R_U_L.note: Heat removal factor * loss coefficient F_R*U_L — very low due to vacuum insulation (~3-5x lower than flat plate)

valid_ranges.note: ETCs operate well at higher T_in than flat plates due to low U_L
